schemaNotes.functionalCategory: True subject area of each tool, independent of which folder its file lives in. Batch 1 and 2 files all live in content/chatbots/ per editorial decision; this field lets Phase 2 re-group into sections without moving or rewriting content.
schemaNotes.status: Present only when a product is not in a normal actively-sold, actively-developed state. Values in use: 'sunset' (shut down), 'product-discontinued' (paid product withdrawn, brand or free tools survive), 'maintenance' (still sold but development halted). Phase 2 should render all three with a visible notice and exclude them from 'best of' listings.
schemaNotes.pageType: Present only on pages that are not standard tool reviews. 'decision-guide' pages answer a purchase question and must internally link to the full review named in relatedTool rather than duplicating it.
schemaNotes.relatedTool: Slug of the full review a decision-guide page supports. Phase 2 should cross-link these two pages in both directions.
schemaNotes.statusValues: Extended in batch 4 with 'uncertain-status' — a free experiment whose backend was shut down and whose current live state cannot be verified from public sources. Phase 2 should render it with a neutral 'status unverified' notice, not a hard 'discontinued' label, and exclude it from 'best of' listings.

July 2026 fair-use hearing scheduled but NO confirmed ruling as of 9 Aug 2026 - state as pending, do NOT claim an outcome. Rival Udio settled with both. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.positioning: Leading AI meeting transcription, now pushing agentic assistance
tools.startingPrice: Free tier (~300 min/month); paid reported from ~$16.99/month (Pro) and ~$30/month (Business), plus enterprise (verify on vendor page)
tools.editorialNote: Repositioned Apr 2026 as a 'Conversational Knowledge Engine'; launched 'Live Assist' 21 Jul 2026. Features: real-time transcription, AI Chat over meetings, OtterPilot (auto-joins Zoom/Meet/Teams), Sales Agent, summaries/action items, MCP support. Reported Free (~300 min/mo)/Pro ~$16.99/Business ~$30 + enterprise. LEGAL: class action In re Otter.AI Privacy Litigation (No. 5:25-cv-06911, N.D. Cal.), consolidated 5 Dec 2025, ONGOING; alleges recording without all-party consent (ECPA/CFAA/CIPA). NO ruling of illegality as of mid-2026 - present as unproven allegations; takeaway: get consent before recording. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: DeepAI
tools.positioning: Cheap, general-purpose multimodal AI playground
tools.startingPrice: Free browser access; a Pro plan is reported at either ~$4.99 or ~$9.99/month depending on the source (both unverified - verify on vendor page)
tools.editorialNote: PARTIAL FIT for a video/audio category - a low-cost MULTIMODAL generator (image gen, AI chat, video gen, TTS); quality is entry-level vs specialist tools (jack-of-all-trades, not best-in-class - stated honestly). Deep AI, Inc. (LA; Kevin Baragona + Peter Griggs). Pricing IN FLUX - Pro reported at either ~$4.99 or ~$9.99/mo (both unverified). Primary domain deepai.org (some pages deepai.com). DO NOT confuse with 'DeepSeek' (different company). Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.positioning: Automation glue that chains media tools together (NOT a media generator)
tools.startingPrice: Free tier (limited tasks); paid Professional reported ~$20/month, scaling with task volume (verify on vendor page)
tools.editorialNote: OFF-CATEGORY (kept deliberately): an automation/orchestration platform, NOT a media generator - stated up front and reinforced in a dedicated note. Relevance framed as the connective layer that CHAINS media tools (e.g. transcript -> summariser, text -> AI voice, trigger an avatar render and publish). Connects 6,000+ apps via triggers/actions ('Zaps'). AI layer: AI by Zapier, Agents, Chatbots, Canvas, Copilot, MCP. Freemium; Professional ~$20/mo (verify). 'Media automation' is a DESCRIPTIVE framing, NOT an official Zapier product/tier. No scandal.

tools.name: Durable
tools.positioning: AI website builder (NOT a video/audio tool) for showcasing/hosting media
tools.startingPrice: Free plan; paid tiers reported ~$25/month (Launch) and ~$99/month (Grow), or ~$22 and ~$85 annually (verify on vendor page)
tools.editorialNote: OFF-CATEGORY (kept deliberately): an AI WEBSITE BUILDER (+ small-business CRM/invoicing/AI agents), NOT a video/audio tool - stated plainly up front and reinforced in a dedicated note; only relation to this category is publishing/hosting a site that showcases media work. Generates a site in ~30s from prompts. Correct domain durable.com (NOT .co). Reported (official page ~Apr 2026): Free/Launch ~$25/Grow ~$99 (~$22/~$85 annual); older '$12' figure OUTDATED. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Simplified
tools.positioning: All-in-one design/content/social suite (video is a minor module; no standalone audio)
tools.startingPrice: Free tier; Pro reported ~$24-29/month with higher Business and Growth tiers (second-hand - verify on vendor page)
tools.editorialNote: BORDERLINE for this category (kept deliberately): an all-in-one design + content + social-marketing suite where VIDEO is a minor secondary module and there is essentially NO standalone audio tool - stated clearly early. TLDR Technologies, Inc. (CEO KD Deshpande); ~$8.5M seed; repositioning as an 'agentic OS for marketing'. Reported Free/Pro ~$24-29 + Business/Growth. Honest con: breadth-over-depth - individual modules (video included) shallower than specialists. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: LucidPic
tools.positioning: Image-first AI headshot/photo generator with a nascent video wrapper
tools.startingPrice: Pricing reported inconsistently - variously an ~$10 'unlimited' option or tiers near ~$8 and ~$29 (second-hand and conflicting - verify on vendor page)
tools.editorialNote: BORDERLINE for this category (kept deliberately): IMAGE-FIRST AI photo/headshot generator; recently added a BASIC image-to-video capability by bundling third-party models (e.g. a Kling 3.0 wrapper), but fundamentally an image tool with NO audio - stated clearly. Pricing CONFLICTS across sources (~$10 'unlimited' vs ~$8/~$29 tiers) - presented as second-hand. CRITICAL disambiguation: NOT 'LucidPix' (3D-photo app by Lucid) and NOT 'Lucidchart' (diagramming); do not merge their facts. Parent company/founder NOT reliably documented - not invented. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.positioning: The aesthetic benchmark for AI image generation, with a distinctive painterly quality
tools.startingPrice: No standing free tier; paid plans reported to begin near ~$10/month (Basic) up to ~$120 (Mega) - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: Independent, self-funded lab (David Holz, founded 2021). VERSION written conservatively: v7 (Apr 2025) is the last FIRMLY verified major model; V8/V8.1 mentioned by some 2026 sources but sourcing inconsistent - not asserted. Web app is now primary interface; Discord still supported. V1 image-to-video exists. LAWSUIT (ongoing, unproven): Disney + NBCUniversal (filed Jun 11 2025) and a separate Warner Bros. suit, consolidated Nov 4 2025 - in discovery, no liability finding. Ignored the unverified 'Midjourney Medical' claim. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly
tools.positioning: The commercially-safe generator with paid-plan IP indemnification
tools.startingPrice: Free tier (limited monthly credits, watermarked); paid reportedly from ~$9.99/month - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: MODEL: Image Model 4 / 4 Ultra (Apr 24 2025) is the documented flagship; Image Model 5 emerging/in preview (GA date unverified); Models 1-3 legacy. Trained on licensed Adobe Stock + public-domain content; paid plans carry IP indemnification (excludes beta, covers copyright not trademark/publicity, excludes user inputs). IMPORTANT nuance stated in article: newer third-party PARTNER models (e.g. Google 'Nano Banana', Flux, Imagen) generally fall OUTSIDE Adobe's commercial-safety guarantee. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Leonardo AI
tools.positioning: Feature-rich image/video generator, Canva-owned but run as a standalone brand
tools.startingPrice: Free tier (daily token allowance); paid reported ~$12/mo and up - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: ACQUIRED BY CANVA (announced Jul 29 2024, reported >US$320M); runs as standalone. Sydney-based, founded Dec 2022 (CEO JJ Fiasson). In-house Phoenix model (Jun 2024) + Kino XL + integrated third-party models. CORRECTIONS stated in article: NO Leonardo feature called 'Flow' (that is Google's tool - Leonardo integrates Google Veo); name collides with unrelated 'Leonardo' products. Canva's Dream Lab is built on Leonardo's Phoenix. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Canva AI
tools.positioning: Mass-market design suite whose Magic Studio wraps generation into a full workflow
tools.startingPrice: Capable free tier; Pro reported ~$15/month (sources vary) - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: AI umbrella brand = Magic Studio (Magic Write/Design/Media, Dream Lab image gen built on Leonardo Phoenix, Canva Code, conversational AI). Apr 2026 'Canva AI 2.0' launched (proprietary model + reported OpenAI image tech - second-hand). CORRECTION stated: there is NO 'Visual Suite 2.0'. CONTROVERSY (balanced): 2024-25 pricing backlash - Teams hike (~Sept 2025) drew backlash, Canva partially reversed w/ legacy safeguards + 'pricing promise'; credit-drain complaints; Affinity made free (Oct 2025) but freemium w/ AI behind subscription. Dream Lab trails Midjourney on photorealism (second-hand). Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.positioning: The specialist for legible, accurate text rendered inside images
tools.startingPrice: Free tier (limited weekly credits); paid reported from ~$8 up to ~$42 - sources conflict, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: Independent; founded 2022 by ex-Google Brain/Imagen researchers; $80M Series A (a16z, 2024) reported. HQ discrepancy noted (older sources SF, 2026 sources Toronto). VERSION past 2.0/3.0: Ideogram 3.0 (Mar 26 2025); flagship Ideogram 4.0 (Jun 3 2026) - first open-weight text-to-image model, native 2K; licence reported inconsistently (flagged unconfirmed); 2.0/2a Turbo legacy. Canvas w/ Magic Fill + Extend; caveat: Magic Fill works on 2.0/3.0 not 4.0. Core differentiator = ~90-95% text-rendering accuracy. Pricing conflicting/second-hand.

tools.name: Magnific AI
tools.positioning: AI upscaler/enhancer that invents plausible new detail rather than just enlarging
tools.startingPrice: Paid, bundled into Freepik's subscription/credit system; a monthly figure was reported but is unverified - confirm on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: ACQUIRED BY FREEPIK (May 2024, Freepik's largest acquisition then); runs as subsidiary; brand consolidated under magnific.com. Founders Javi Lopez + Emilio Nicolas, founded Nov 2023 in Murcia, Spain; bootstrapped. FLAGSHIP: Mystic text-to-image (co-developed w/ Freepik, Aug 2024, native 2K); 'Mystic 2.5' reported (version numbers second-hand). Two upscaler modes distinguished in article: Creative (up to 16x, hallucinates detail) vs Precision (faithful ~2x, mid-2025, for photographers); plus Relight, Style Transfer, video upscaler, API. CONTROVERSY corrected: NO substantiated 'copy Midjourney' scandal - it was founder self-promotion (Dec 2023); style-copy LAWSUITS target Midjourney/Stability, NOT Magnific. Pricing unverified.

tools.name: Remove.bg
tools.positioning: Narrow single-purpose background-removal utility (NOT a generator)
tools.startingPrice: Freemium - free previews at limited resolution; paid credits/subscriptions and ~$0.20/image API reported but figures vary - verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: UTILITY, not a generator (stated plainly). Built by Kaleido AI (Vienna; remove.bg launched 2018); ACQUIRED BY CANVA Feb 2021 (price undisclosed; ~$100M speculated - unconfirmed); Kaleido entity renamed Canva Austria GmbH; remove.bg still standalone-branded; sibling Unscreen (video bg removal) in same deal. Features: one-click removal, high-res, API (per-image), bulk, Photoshop/Figma/Zapier integrations. No substantiated controversies. Pricing second-hand/promotional.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.positioning: BORDERLINE (kept deliberately): AI presentation/website/document generator, closer to productivity than fine art
tools.startingPrice: Freemium; Pro reported ~$18/month and premium Ultra ~$100/month - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: BORDERLINE for Design & Art (kept, framed as productivity-adjacent, stated in article). Independent, lean team (~50). FLAGSHIP: Gamma 3.0 (Sept 2025) added Gamma Agent (web research w/ citations), restyling, API, premium Ultra tier. Funding well-corroborated: $68M Series B at $2.1B valuation (Nov 10 2025, a16z-led); surpassed $100M ARR; profitable since 2023; ~70M users. CRITICISM (balanced): 'AI slop' - generic/repetitive layouts, distorted images, weak presenting mode, messy PPT export; note many critics are competing tools (bias caveat). Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Namecheap Logo Maker

tools.startingPrice: Free to design; a Namecheap account sign-in is required to download or share - verify current terms on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: BORDERLINE for Design & Art (kept, framed honestly as a free registrar freebie with thin/unverified 'AI', stated in article). A question-driven wizard + templates + icon/font library from the domain registrar Namecheap; part of its 'Visual' suite. CORRECTION: NO evidence it is powered by Tailor Brands (competitors); Namecheap's relevant acquisition was Stencil. 'AI-powered' treated as marketing-grade/unverified; no underlying model invented. Reported free, no watermark, no card - but account sign-in needed to download; copyright/trademark caveat noted. No controversies. Details second-hand.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.positioning: The leading agentic AI code editor for professional developers
tools.startingPrice: Free 'Hobby' tier; Pro reported ~$20/month with higher usage tiers (Pro+, Ultra) above - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: Company Anysphere Inc. (founded 2022, four MIT classmates, CEO Michael Truell). Began as VS Code fork; now agentic IDE w/ own Composer models (latest ~Composer 2.5, May 2026). Funding: Series C ~$900M at ~$9-9.9B (Jun 2025); Series D $2.3B at $29.3B (Nov 2025); >$1B ARR late 2025. MAJOR pending claim (hedged in article): ~$60B all-stock SpaceX acquisition widely reported Jun 2026, expected close Q3 2026 - framed as reported/pending not done. PRICING CONTROVERSY (balanced): Jun 2025 Pro shift to usage-based credits marketed 'unlimited' caused backlash; CEO apologised Jul 7 2025; existing users grandfathered. Free tier is 'Hobby' (not 'Free'); no 'Ultra Teams'. Features: Tab, Agent Mode/parallel agents (Cursor 3.0 Apr 2026), Background Agents, Bugbot (Jul 2025), MCP, JetBrains, mobile. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Replit
tools.positioning: Browser-based AI app builder pivoting hard toward non-coders ('vibe coding')
tools.startingPrice: Free 'Starter' tier (daily-refreshing Agent credits); Core reported ~$20/month plus usage - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: Browser IDE + AI app builder; CEO Amjad Masad; pivoted to 'vibe coding' through 2025. Funding: Series C $250M at $3B (Sept 2025); Series D $400M at $9B (Mar 2026); ~$150M ARR. Replit Agent: orig Sept 2024, v2 Feb 2025, Agent 3 (Sept 10 2025, much more autonomous, self-tests in browser). INCIDENT (verified, framed factually): JULY 2025 (NOT September) - Jason Lemkin (SaaStr) reported Replit's Agent DELETED a production database (~1,200 records) during a code freeze, ignored instructions, misreported; data later recovered. CEO called it 'unacceptable'; added dev/prod DB separation, better rollback, planning-only mode. 'Cover-up/faked data' = Lemkin's reported account, not independent finding. PRICING (balanced): 2026 'Effort-Based Pricing' (agent decides cost, revealed after) reached Core/Teams ~Jul 1 2026, backlash over unpredictability; Jul 11 2026 billing bug over-charged, Replit credited users. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Framer
tools.positioning: No-code AI website builder that grew out of a design/prototyping tool
tools.startingPrice: Free plan; paid reported from ~$10/month per site (billed annually), extra editor seats charged separately - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: Independent (not acquired); founded ~2014 Amsterdam by Koen Bok + Jorn van Dijk (ex-Sofa). Pivoted from prototyping to full website builder. Funding: $100M Series D at $2B (Aug 2025, Meritech + Atomico); ~500k MAU, ~$100M ARR pace. FLAGSHIP: Framer 3.0 (Aug 2026) - AI agents on canvas + AI credits + simplified plans; Framer I/O 2025 launched AI suite (Wireframer, Workshop reportedly Claude-powered). CORRECTION stated: NO 'Mini' plan - Mini/Launch discontinued in Oct 2025 restructuring; entry paid tier is 'Basic'; pricing is per-site + per-seat. COMPLAINTS (balanced, user sentiment not lawsuits): vendor lock-in / NO code export (most consistent); Oct 2025 pricing overhaul backlash; per-site/seat fees costly for agencies. DISAMBIGUATION stated: Framer Motion (React lib) was spun off + renamed 'Motion' (motion.dev), separate product. Pricing second-hand.

tools.name: Notion (Projects & Agents)
tools.positioning: Notion's project-management side seen through its new AI agents (distinct from the Notion AI writing review)
tools.startingPrice: Free plan; paid reported from ~$10/user/month (Plus), ~$20 Business (bundles Notion AI); Custom Agents metered via Notion Credits - second-hand, verify on vendor page
tools.editorialNote: DELIBERATELY NON-DUPLICATIVE of the existing writing-research/notion-ai.md review: this page is the PROJECT-MANAGEMENT + AGENTS angle only (databases, Timeline/Gantt/dependencies/critical path, sprints; personal Notion Agent from Notion 3.0 Sept 18 2025 - autonomous ~20min runs, NO credit cost; trigger-based Custom Agents - avail Business/Enterprise Feb 24 2026, free through May 3 2026, credit-metered from May 4 2026; Enterprise Search May 2025; Mail/Calendar/Slack as Custom Agent connectors Apr 2026). Writing-assistant + AI-pricing detail deferred to the companion Notion AI review (referenced in prose, no URL). PM LIMITS (balance): strains on large programs (200+ linked tasks), no built-in resource mgmt/exec reporting vs Jira/MS Project/Smartsheet - best for small-to-moderate teams. SECURITY: PromptArmor prompt-injection/exfiltration disclosure publicised Jan 7 2026 (Notion says remediated); a Jun 2026 'breach' claim was investigated and publicly called FRAUDULENT by Notion (dispute, not confirmed breach). No SKU literally named 'Notion Projects & AI'. Pricing second-hand.
